records.people: Karamo Kaba (16th Governor of the Banque Centrale de la République de Guinée since December 2021)
records.move: from Economist Strategist and then Director of Economic Research at the asset manager Ecofi Investissements (2003-2021) to Governor of the Banque Centrale de la République de Guinée (December 2021)
records.summary: A Rencontres Economiques speaker profile says that since December 2021 Karamo Kaba has been the 16th Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Guinea, and that from 2003 to 2021 he was Economist Strategist and then Director of Economic Research at Ecofi Investissements; it also lists earlier work as portfolio manager and financial analyst at ACOFI Gestion and as an economist at the agricultural cooperative union InVivo. Club Patrimoine describes Ecofi as a societe de gestion - an asset management company - and a subsidiary of the Credit Cooperatif group. Neither page gives Ecofi's head-office city, so none is recorded.
records.source_title: Karamo Kaba, Governor, Central Bank of the Republic of Guinea (Les Rencontres Economiques d'Aix-en-Provence 2024)
records.quote: From 2003 to 2021, Economist Strategist then Director of Economic Research at ECOFI Investissements
